events.title: 미들즈브러 pay a club record £8.15million for 엠폴리 and Italy striker 마시모 마카로네 .
리즈 유나이티드 appoint Terry Venables as their new manager.

AFC 윔블던 , a club founded by former supporters of 윔블던 following The FA's approval of the latter club's move to Milton Keynes , play their first match, losing 4–0 in a preseason friendly to 서턴 유나이티드 in front of over 4,600 fans.
아스널 sign defender Pascal Cygan from 릴 for £2.1million.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign 20-year-old defender 타이터스 브램블 from 입스위치 타운 for £5million.

맨체스터 유나이티드 break the English transfer record for the third time in just over a year. They pay 리즈 유나이티드 £29 million for central defender 리오 퍼디난드 , amidst reports that the Yorkshire club are in severe financial difficulties after overspending during the previous 3 seasons, and having a crippling loan debt.
에버턴 sign 아스널 goalkeeper 리처드 라이트 for £3.5million.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sell out-of-favour striker Dwight Yorke to 블랙번 로버스 for £2million, with Graeme Souness partnering Yorke with his former 맨체스터 유나이티드 strike partner Andy Cole .
버밍엄 시티 , newly promoted to the Premier League, pay a club record £4.25million for 크리스털 팰리스 striker Clinton Morrison .
